findings.title: Claim trust is not content-pinned
findings.claim: The claim writes the holder without pinning the descriptor hash.
findings.impact: A descriptor can change after review and still execute.
findings.recommendation: Persist a trust record keyed by content hash.
findings.nextEvidenceAction: Mutate a descriptor and assert refusal.

findings.title: Stale claims never expire
findings.claim: No transition leaves the stale state without operator force.
findings.impact: A lapsed holder blocks the lane indefinitely.

findings.claim: Hostile title and path ../../../../etc/passwd must render inert.
counterEvidence: The cockpit never uses innerHTML for atlas data.

findings.title: Route lacks a determinism class
findings.claim: The gamma flow carries no determinism classification.

findings.title: Observation absence is recorded as unknown
findings.claim: The fixture is referenced but never observed running.
findings.impact: A static reference is not a runtime observation.
counterEvidence: The reference is a static mapping only.

findings.title: Diagram catalog is metadata only
findings.claim: The diagram index carries no diagram bodies.
findings.impact: Bodies must be read from the .mmd files.

findings.title: Degree-inflation edges lacked a fixture-native label
findings.claim: Earlier fixture drafts used `owns`/`realizes` for degree filler, contaminating domain derivation.
findings.impact: Would have produced a false-positive domain assignment for 256 filler entities.
findings.recommendation: Use a neutral 'related-to' type for pure degree inflation.
